<subject>Re: Fund strategy meeting follow up</subject>
<body>
Good call.

My main points would be that (a) Cedar Point needs to move forward with its "right-sized" fund structures and (b) prioritize streamlining reporting standards and governance [no more drawn-out joint committees]. Just two clear, straightforward ideas.

Also, I believe it’s misleading to use the term "mega funds." We don’t want mega funds. We want funds that align closely with target sectors and deliver value to investors.

Preston
</body>
<quoted>
 -----Original Message-----
